text:
Maria: Quick heads-up from today's vendor lane  vendors reshuffled a couple of dates that affect marketplace listing windows and SI onramp. Need a short triage. cc @Jess @Cheng @Kevin

vendor-feed-bot: Vendor bulletin: NVIDIA H200 micro-shipment slipped 10 days -> 2026-05-16. H100 replen scheduled 2026-05-05. MI300 roadmap unchanged. Habana/Gaudi requested firmware hold until 2026-05-17.

Kevin: OK. Two immediate questions: (1) do we mark affected SKUs `listing_state: withheld` or `preannounce`? (2) can we provide partners with a pinned, non-production node image for SI?

Jess: SI needs a stable image they can boot without kernel juggling. If platform can supply a pinned-image with drivers baked in, partners can run E2E tests. We also need the perf smoke harness included.

Cheng: Lab status: can free up 8 H100 GPUs next week and 4 B200 nodes are live but running driver 1.4.2 which misreports PCIe stats on kernel 6.1. Kernel 6.3 images look clean.

Maria: provisional approach: withhold marketplace SKUs until platform closes compatibility tickets. Meanwhile hand integrators a staging image with explicit driver pins and a README. Marketing stays on standby.

Priya: marketing ask: if we're withholding, prepare a short customer-facing statement and an internal changelog for partner ops. We can craft a "ready to announce" checklist to speed things once vendor lift occurs.

Kevin: Plan I can execute:
- Build `redwood-node:hw-staging-b200-pinned-20260505` with driver 1.4.3 pinned and kernel 6.3.
- Build `redwood-node:hw-staging-h100-contingency-20260505` for SI smoke.
- Add `feature.quant_fallback=true` toggle in the image env to enable q4_8 fallback for degraded float32 paths.
ETA: build and push by 2026-05-05.

Jess: please also include `/opt/redwood/smoke.sh` that runs 3 quick scenarios and emits a JSON perf report. We'll give that to partners.

Cheng: I can allocate the 8 H100s on 2026-05-06 and reserve 4 B200 nodes for partner runs, but I need an infra ticket to set kernel modules at boot. Opening PLAT-5130.

Maria: I created PLT-5131 to track marketplace metadata changes (`listing_state`, `preannounce_eta`, `compat_matrix_version`). We'll gate flips on that ticket closure.

vendor-feed-bot: Note: Gaudi firmware embargo request for 2026-05-17 recorded.

Priya: we'll prepare a holding press kit and an internal FAQ. Draft will be ready 2026-05-08. No outward scheduling until `listing_state`=public.

Kevin: small UX ask: put `README_QUANT_FALLBACK.md` in the image root explaining cost/perf tradeoffs partners will see when the fallback is enabled.

Jess: also include an eval prompt set named `si-annex-quant-fallback` so partners can compare outputs.

Cheng: PLAT-5130 opened, assigning to `lab-ops`. PLT-5131 linked.

Maria: action items recap: (1) Kevin build two staging images + push smoke harness + README, (2) Cheng reserve GPUs and attach PLAT-5130, (3) Jess prepare prompt set and partner instructions, (4) Priya draft holding comms and FAQ, (5) Platform tickets PLAT-5130/PLT-5131 must be closed before any marketplace flip. Reply with :thumbsup: or call out blockers.

Kevin: :thumbsup: building images now, will report push status.

Jess: :thumbsup: prompt set in flight.

Cheng: :thumbsup: reserving nodes, will follow up in PLAT-5130.

Priya: :thumbsup: drafting comms.

Maria: thanks all  we'll reconvene if vendor dates shift further and will post a final checklist once PLT-5131 is green.
